messages:
alejandro: Quick thread: we need a concrete client-facing contract for cross-mode fallbacks. Ops keeps getting noisy because client UX varies per-mode.

miriam: Yup. Suggest we standardize a compact canonical error set and a tiny header surface so SDKs can hide mode differences.

jonah: Proposed canonical codes: SUCCESS, THROTTLE, PERM_DENIED, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE, INVALID_CONFIG, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, MODEL_PIN_MISMATCH. Keep it intentionally small.

alejandro: Good list. Add that runtime/adapters must not leak sensitive internal text in the canonical message. Extra debug info can be exposed in optional headers for ops.

carol_devex: SDK side: we can parse headers: `X-RW-ERR` (canonical), `X-RW-MODE` (hosted|dedicated|private), `X-RW-DBG` (internal_code, opt-in), `X-RW-TRACE-ID`. Example snippet in SDK README:

  // pseudocode
  if (resp.headers['x-rw-err']) {
    clientErr = resp.headers['x-rw-err']
    mode = resp.headers['x-rw-mode'] || 'hosted'
    trace = resp.headers['x-rw-trace-id']
  }

jonah: Implementation detail: router boundary should be the canonicalizer. Adapters implement a tiny translate function: `translate(err, ctx) -> (canonical, mode_hint, internal_code)` where ctx = {tenant_id?, model_pin?} (minimal). Keep translation O(1).

miriam: Semver rules for translator: major bump when canonical set changes or mapping semantics change. Router must include translator version in adapter handshake. If mismatch and no compat table, treat as BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE for safety.

alejandro: Telemetry: private deployments may block outgoing logs. Minimum required signals we mandate: `X-RW-TRACE-ID` must be returned when available; if not allowed, adapter must return `X-RW-MODE: private` and `X-RW-ERR` at minimum. Optional: sampled stack traces and internal_code if admin consent.

ops-bot: Action created: ARCH-ERRCONTRACT-1758129999. Assignees: miriam, jonah, carol_devex. Due: 72h.

carol_devex: Docs: show examples for suppressed telemetry case and for full-telemetry case. Also add guidance on client retry behavior: if `X-RW-MODE` flips between attempts, clients should back off longer and avoid aggressive retries. Example: exponential backoff with max 3 retries across mode changes.

jonah: Perf budget: translator must add <100ns median overhead in hot path (inline table lookup). No heavy string ops. We should prefer integer codes in headers to reduce parse cost e.g., `X-RW-ERR: 3` with mapping table in SDK.

miriam: Validation metrics: mis-translation rate (canonical != sampled trace root cause) < 0.05% over 5m; missing header rate < 0.1% over 10m for hosted/dedicated; private exempt but require clear flagging in dashboard.

alejandro: Securitynote: KMS/key failures surface as INVALID_CONFIG or PERM_DENIED; never expose key identifiers in canonical. internal_code ok for ops when customer allows.

miriam: Model-pinning edge: MODEL_PIN_MISMATCH should be emitted when tenant requests model X but backend only has Y pinned. Translator must include `model_hint` in debug header.

carol_devex: Small SDK change: provide helper to map numeric codes to enums and a `diagnostics()` opt-in call that requests expanded debug payload when allowed by server.

alejandro: Rollout plan: feature-flag translator v1.1, canary 5% tenants, collect metrics above, flip gating when mis-translation < threshold for 24h. Maintain compat table for 30d to support older dedicated/private runtimes.

ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up sync in 3d.

jonah: Open question: should clients get a stable retry token when fallback occurs so we can dedupe retries across modes? Could be useful, but adding state to hot path increases complexity. Mark as follow-up.

miriam: I'll own canonical code doc + validation queries.

jonah: I'll own translator interface PR + perf microbenchmarks.

carol_devex: I'll own SDK header helpers and docs snippet.

alejandro: Thanks. If anyone hits other fallout (billing, SLO pages), drop notes in the ARCH-ERRCONTRACT thread.
